description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. This value must be unique for each request and can contain only ASCII characters.
The ID of the service review request.

descriptions.zh: 只有已提交状态的服务审核申请支持取消。
descriptions.en: Service review requests can be canceled only if they are in the Submitted state.
